category_definitions.PLATFORM: DOS, BIOS, device, runtime, interrupt, startup, file, timer, or host-service boundary.
category_definitions.LEGACY_SOFTWARE_RENDERER: Software rasterization, shape, sprite, font, palette, or indexed-surface algorithm.
category_definitions.PORTABLE_ALGORITHM: Platform-independent math, state transformation, or data algorithm that still requires a behavior-preserving translation.
category_definitions.HISTORICAL_CRT-DEAD-NOP: Pinned historical CRT members and verified no-op/dead entries retained for exact historical coverage; replace or preserve according to their individual semantics and reachability.
